authority: Authoritative for the individual development steps of a task and whether each step is officially finished. Task ownership, leases and paths stay in ACTIVE_TASKS.json; milestones, weights and progress percentages stay in PROJECT_STATUS.json and are deliberately not repeated here.

step_statuses.PLANNED: Defined, not started. May not start until every earlier step is COMPLETED and ChatGPT (under Lukas's standing instruction) or Lukas has authorized it.
step_statuses.IN_PROGRESS: The one step currently being worked on.
step_statuses.READY_FOR_REVIEW: Work stopped. Evidence reported; waiting for ChatGPT's review. Claude does not approve its own step.
step_statuses.COMPLETED: Technically approved by ChatGPT with Lukas's confirmation recorded as DIRECT or REPORTED (see the protocol, section 3a). Terminal: never edited afterwards.

steps.title: Step 2: snapshot builder (dashboard/build_snapshot.py)
acceptance_criteria: Python standard library only; reads PROJECT_STATUS.json, ACTIVE_TASKS.json and DEVELOPMENT_TRACKER.json and writes a snapshot file; never modifies project status

No secrets, credentials, private local paths or footage in the snapshot

Tests cover snapshot generation, cleanliness reporting and the exclusions above
